title: Senior IT Business System Analyst
job_description:
Bachelor's in IT, Computer Science, Business, or related field Master's (MBA or IS) is a plus 3+ years’ experience in Business Systems Analysis Strong in API testing, data analysis, system integration Familiar with tools: Postman, Tableau/Power BI, JIRA, Git Knowledge of SDLC, Agile/Scrum, ERP/CRM systems Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Strong problem-solving mindset and team collaboration

Analyze and document business requirements Design and propose IT solutions to support business goals Collaborate with technical teams on implementation Perform system and process analysis Lead or support integration projects (APIs, enterprise platforms) Ensure project milestones and outcomes are met

Annual Leave Medical and Hospitalisation Leave EIS Annual Bonus EPF SOCSO 5 Working Days Medical Insurance

Data Integration Scrum API Development system analysis UAT Stakeholder Management Problem Solving Business Management System Enhancement
